dedupeText: naive minimalist line art cover hand drawn minimalist black and white naive art felt tip pen portrait sketch vertical symmetry between centered portrait and horizontal text blocks contrast between thick bold upper lettering and thin delicate lower lettering relationship between the wobbly imperfect hand drawn lines and the vast negative space combine a naive ink portrait with a bold marker header and a light fine liner footer all centered on a white field

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white composition featuring a centered, naive-style line drawing of a male face wearing a fedora, framed by hand-lettered text at the top and bottom against a pure white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between centered portrait and horizontal text blocks
Contrast between thick, bold upper lettering and thin, delicate lower lettering
Relationship between the wobbly, imperfect hand-drawn lines and the vast negative space
coreInvariants: Intentional 'naive' or 'outsider art' aesthetic with shaky line quality

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the sketch, rendered as small concentric circles.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan from the bold header to the central face, ending at the smaller footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive, surrounding the central figure to emphasize isolation and simplicity.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black ink for all graphic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Binary value system (0 or 100) with no grayscale or shading.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular stroke widths mimicking a felt-tip marker
Rounded terminals and organic, shaky curves
characterSpecificRedesigns: Upper text: Thick, blocky, and slightly distorted
Lower text: Thin, small-scale, and widely tracked
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast in weight and scale between top and bottom text to create a frame.

preserve: Wide tracking on the bottom line

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the thick, organic feel of the top text.
Captures the clean but manual feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a minimalist black line drawing of a man's face with a fedora in a naive, shaky ink style on a pure white background. Leave ample space at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-lettered all-caps text at the top in a thick marker style and at the bottom in a thin, widely-spaced fine-liner style.

verificationChecks: Are the lines strictly black with no gray?
Is the text hand-drawn rather than a standard font?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the bottom text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no anti-aliasing artifacts create gray tones.
Check that the top text is significantly bolder than the bottom text.
Verify the 'naive' style doesn't look too professional or polished.
Confirm the fedora is clearly defined by simple outlines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a naive ink portrait with a bold marker header and a light fine-liner footer, all centered on a white field.
